limitations: Percentages are numeric values on a 0 to 100 scale, with no percent sign; used resource / VCU118 capacity * 100.
BRAM18-equivalent = 2 * RAMB36 primitives + RAMB18 primitives; VCU118 capacity is4320 BRAM18-equivalent or2160 BRAM36-equivalent. BRAM36-equivalent is not the physical count of RAMB36 primitives.
FPGA power and energy are post-route vectorless on-chip estimates, not board measurements.

CPU energy is measured over matching active windows from both CPU-package counters on shared Supernova; background activity is included. Paired-background-adjusted energy is separate and is not isolated process energy.
CPU/GPU hardware cycles and benchmark memory/resource usage were not measured; blank means unavailable, never zero.
Software throughput from reciprocal mean latency differs from independently measured sustained throughput. Energy-window throughput and FPGA31-interval service throughput are separately labeled.
The validated workload contains32 inputs; native/scalar/RTL output equivalence does not by itself establish general decoding success rates.

GPU total-device counters exclude host CPU/RAM and whole-server energy; CPU package counters exclude DRAM and whole-server power; FPGA figures exclude board I/O and board power. CPU/GPU measured energy versus FPGA estimated energy is not a matched measured whole-platform comparison.
CPU correctness: 11 full 32-input validation passes, 1,760 output-field comparisons, zero mismatches. Five matched active windows contain 66,720 decodings; raw samples remain remote.
CPU paired-background adjustment is a point estimate whose conservative sampling bounds include zero. It must not support an isolated decoding-energy ranking.
CPU counter-wrap admissibility assumes at most 2,000 W per package. No wraps observed; all window endpoints bracketed. Sampling bounds are not confidence intervals or counter-accuracy bounds.

Only the nine latest-design C1/C2/C4 x V2/V4/V8 points are included. All nine passed full-group CNU II=1, VNU II=1, 32-input RTL verification and routed 100 MHz timing. All vendor workflows are closed.
